goal: Make VII search intelligence reliable and turn the administration system into a coherent operational path from observed demand to approved public page.

intent_model.literal_request: Improve everything, make performed searches appear, and add the many missing administration capabilities.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A premium but easy management system that operators can trust every day, with complete search evidence and direct next actions.
likely_rejections: The latest administrator search is absent.
Only summary cards exist without actionable detail.
Internal tests distort real visitor demand.
The workflow ends before editing, approval, publication or sitemap inclusion.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory and connect the full affected administration family rather than polishing one card.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: All connected search-intelligence routes and states receive explicit coverage.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: What people searched and what requires action now.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose one demand signal or administrator test to inspect.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the matching page opportunity for editing or review.
deferred_complexity: Detailed SEO and GEO metadata fields

natural_destination: The live VII administration routes and their D1-backed search records.

facts.claim: The current client returns before sending any search event unless the browser consent value is all.
The current administrator analytics report excludes internal events and returns aggregate groups only.
The search-page studio already separates internal tests from public demand in the release branch.

assumptions.claim: The user's browser is signed in as an address listed in VII_ADMIN_EMAILS.
assumptions.validation: Verify the authenticated production route and returned administrator account after deployment.

in_scope: Authenticated administrator test capture without public analytics consent
Recent public and internal search inventories
Top intent ranking and zero-result signals
Direct transition from intelligence to the matching editing workspace
Full route and permission regression for the search administration family
out_of_scope: Connecting unverified external GA4, Search Console or Tag Manager accounts
Publishing pages automatically without editorial approval
Provisioning the future Aurora and high-volume analytics target architecture
Changing supplier catalogs or triggering supplier pulls
invariants: Public analytics is stored only after explicit measurement consent.
Administrator tests never increase public demand, unique visitor or zero-result metrics.
Robots remain blocked for drafts and internal-only opportunities.
Unauthorized administration requests return 403 and no sensitive data.
The existing page editor, version history and sitemap publication flow remain available.
affected_family: vacation, events, spa and hourly result producers

requirements.statement: A signed-in administrator search is persisted and visible as an internal test even without public analytics consent.
Internal tests are separated from public demand and cannot inflate public metrics or approval priority.
Search intelligence shows recent actionable detail, not only aggregates.
The operator can open the matching page opportunity and continue the content workflow.
The flow works across all four commercial search families and protected administration states.

acceptance_checks.setup: Signed-in administrator with no public analytics consent
acceptance_checks.action: Perform a filtered search and allow results to settle
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A recent internal test row appears with world, location, filters, result count, route and time.

acceptance_checks.setup: One internal test and one consented public search exist
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The internal test remains in its own total and row list while public demand totals count only the public search.

acceptance_checks.action: Submit the same candidate event and request the report
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The candidate is not stored and the administration report returns 403.

acceptance_checks.action: Inspect the intelligence row and choose its action
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The UI explains the intent and opens /admin/search-pages?id=<opportunity> directly.

acceptance_checks.setup: No events exist in the selected period
acceptance_checks.observable_result: An explicit useful empty state appears without fake data.

acceptance_checks.setup: The report request or event save fails
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The interface shows a recoverable error and does not claim data was saved.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative search state in each commercial world
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each world emits the same bounded detailed event contract.
The current task and primary next action remain visible and usable without overflow.

open_questions.question: Which external analytics and search accounts will ultimately be connected?
open_questions.resolution: Keep them explicitly unverified until Adir supplies the account and scope.

authorization_boundary: Implement, test, commit and push the repair. Do not connect external accounts, mutate supplier catalogs or claim production completion before verified deployment.
